name.zh: 聚氨酯地坪漆涂装系统

intro.zh: 聚氨酯地坪涂装系统包括聚氨酯底漆、中涂、面漆、罩面清漆、无溶剂自流平及超耐磨地坪漆等。该涂装体系具有防尘防潮、高耐磨、施工快捷、维护方便等特点，是一般生产车间、办公室的首选涂装系统。
intro.en: The polyurethane floor system covers primer, body coat, topcoat, clear sealer, solvent-free self-leveling and super abrasion-resistant coatings. It is dust- and moisture-proof, highly abrasion resistant, quick to apply and easy to maintain, and is the first-choice system for ordinary workshops and offices.

body.zh:
**产品概况**
- 产品型号 9008，聚氨酯薄涂，配套固化剂 G406，理论用量 0.2kg/㎡；符合标准 Q/584632UQA01-2004。
- 聚氨酯薄涂系列是高附着力、高强度、耐磨损、施工简单的专业聚氨酯涂装材料体系。底涂为无色透明质地溶剂，底中通用，按每组小于 20% 比例添加 8 号以上石英粉可做聚氨酯中涂；面涂可兼容各类环氧、聚氨酯地坪做罩面或面涂使用。
- 底、中、面材料施工时可添加石英粉，修补地面细小砂粒孔、龟裂纹，并增加地坪体系的耐重载、抗压耐磨、高强柔韧性。

**施工条件**
- 新水泥地面必须养护 30 天以上；周围温度 5℃–35℃；素地平整、坚固、不起砂；明亮通风；地面高低差 2mm/2M 以下；无交叉施工；地面无油污和渗油；空气湿度 ≤80% R.H；含水率 10% 以下。

**施工步骤**
1. 切缝：用专业水泥地面切割机切割伸缩缝，清除缝隙杂质使之整齐平整，再用修补材料填补缝隙。
2. 研磨：用 50# 合金钢刀头打磨混凝土，露出石子或砂砾使表面顺平；再用 80# 合金钢刀头消除划痕；用 50 目树脂干磨片消除合金钢刀头划痕；用尘推把清理浮灰，为底漆涂装作准备。备注：地面强度需达到 C25 以上；地面强度低于 C20 需先涂装混凝土密封固化剂加固素地。
3. 底漆：A:B = 5:1；用专用涂料搅拌机全面搅拌约 1 分钟至均匀；适量倒在地面，用聚氨酯地坪施工刮刀贴地披刮，要薄而均，披刮后有光泽，无光泽处（粗糙水泥地面）适时补涂。可使用时间：10℃内 60 分钟内；20℃内 30 分钟内；30℃内 15 分钟内。
4. 中涂：A:B = 5:1；搅拌约 1 分钟至均匀后加入适量 8 号石英粉再充分搅拌，倒在地面以刮刀贴地刮批，确保填平砂孔、龟裂纹，表面平整；淡色系可用面漆加 8 号石英粉增加遮盖力；涂装要薄而均，漏涂处适时补涂，确保无漏底。可使用时间：10℃内 50 分钟内；20℃内 25 分钟内；30℃内 10 分钟内。
5. 面漆：A 组份:B 组份 = 5:1；搅拌约 1 分钟至均匀；用聚氨酯地坪施工专用滚筒滚涂，要薄而均，滚涂后有光泽、无漏涂，漏涂处适时补涂。用量 0.1kg/㎡，切记不要超过 0.12kg/㎡：纯聚氨酯体系具弹性，做厚了强度会降低，还容易发泡。可使用时间：10℃内 50 分钟内；20℃内 25 分钟内；30℃内 10 分钟内。

**保养时间**
- 10℃内：步行软底鞋 48 小时后；拖车（1 吨内）7 天；完全固化 10 天。
- 20℃内：40 小时后；5 天；7 天。
- 30℃内：30 小时后；3 天；5 天。

**主要性能**
- 厚度 0.2mm；抗压强度 ≥30MPa；粘接强度 ≥2.0MPa；耐冲击性 Ⅱ级，漆膜无裂纹、无脱落；硬度 4H；固含量 ≥65；耐水性 7 天内轻微变色、耐 H2SO4 20% 2 天无变化、耐 NaOH 25% 2 天无变化、耐 NaCl 10% 3 天无变化、耐汽油 120# 2 天无变化（均符合 GB/T22374-2008）；燃烧性能等级 Bf1；防滑性（干摩擦系数）≥0.50；耐磨性（750G/500R）≤0.30 g；干燥时间 表干 ≤6h、实干 ≤24h；VOC ≤120g/L；苯、游离甲醛、甲苯二甲苯总和、可溶性重金属均未检出；表面效果光亮平整，漆膜饱满。
- 基础参数表：贮存 5℃–25℃ 12 个月；PU 树脂；固体含量 65%；固化剂美国亨斯曼；助剂德国 BYK；硬度 4H；耐酸性（20% H2SO4）2 天轻微变色；耐碱性（20% NaOH）2 天不变色；耐洗擦性 100000 次；表干 6h，实干 48h；一组净重 6kg；包装铁桶及塑料桶。注：该表与上面的性能数据在耐酸、耐碱、实干时间上不一致。

**安全注意事项**
- 放置于阴凉干燥处；长期放置某些规格稍有分层，请先搅拌；按配比称取主剂与固化剂混合，避免硬化不完全；请在可使用时间内用完；勿在雨天或低温环境下施工面涂层，避免表面雾化、分色、白斑；沾到皮肤用肥皂水清洗。
- 紧急处理：立即脱掉受污染衣物；吸入则移至空气新鲜处；皮肤接触用肥皂水和大量水清洗；眼睛接触立即用大量水冲洗后就医；吞入由医生决定是否催吐。
body.en:
**Overview**
- Model 9008 polyurethane thin coat, matching curing agent G406, theoretical consumption 0.2 kg/m²; conforms to Q/584632UQA01-2004.
- The thin-coat polyurethane range is a professional PU coating system with high adhesion, high strength, wear resistance and simple application. The primer is a clear solvent-based coat usable as both primer and body coat: adding less than 20% of No. 8 (or finer) quartz powder per set makes a polyurethane body coat. The topcoat is compatible for use as a sealer or topcoat over epoxy and polyurethane floors.
- Quartz powder may be added to the primer/body/topcoat to fill fine sand holes and hairline cracks and to improve heavy-load capacity, compressive and abrasion resistance, and strength with flexibility.

**Site conditions**
- New concrete cured for more than 30 days; ambient 5–35 °C; substrate flat, sound and non-dusting; bright, ventilated area; surface level variation under 2 mm per 2 m; no trades working at the same time; no oil contamination or seepage; relative humidity ≤80%; moisture content below 10%.

**Procedure**
1. Joint cutting: cut expansion joints with a professional concrete cutter, clear debris so edges are neat and even, then fill with repair material.
2. Grinding: grind the concrete with 50# alloy-steel diamond tooling to expose aggregate and level the surface; use 80# tooling to remove scratches, then 50-mesh resin dry-grinding pads to remove tooling scratches; sweep away dust with a dust mop before priming. Notes: floor strength must be C25 or above; below C20 the substrate must first be consolidated with concrete sealing hardener.
3. Primer (heading lost in the extracted text; inferred from content): A:B = 5:1; mix with a mixer for about 1 min until uniform; pour a suitable amount on the floor and apply tight to the floor with a polyurethane floor squeegee, thin and even, glossy after application; recoat dull areas (rough concrete) in time. Pot life: 60 min at ≤10 °C; 30 min at ≤20 °C; 15 min at ≤30 °C.
4. Body coat: A:B = 5:1; mix about 1 min until uniform, add a suitable amount of No. 8 quartz powder and mix thoroughly, pour on the floor and squeegee tight to the floor to fill sand holes and cracks and level the surface; for light colors, topcoat plus No. 8 quartz powder increases hiding; apply thin and even, touch up missed spots so no substrate shows through. Pot life: 50 min at ≤10 °C; 25 min at ≤20 °C; 10 min at ≤30 °C.
5. Topcoat: A:B = 5:1; mix about 1 min until uniform; apply with a dedicated polyurethane floor roller, thin and even, glossy with no missed areas. Consumption 0.1 kg/m², never more than 0.12 kg/m²: the pure polyurethane system is elastic and strength drops and bubbling occurs if applied too thick. Pot life: 50 min at ≤10 °C; 25 min at ≤20 °C; 10 min at ≤30 °C.

**Curing / return to service**
- ≤10 °C: soft-soled foot traffic after 48 h; trolley (under 1 t) after 7 days; full cure 10 days.
- ≤20 °C: 40 h; 5 days; 7 days.
- ≤30 °C: 30 h; 3 days; 5 days.

**Key performance**
- Thickness 0.2 mm; compressive strength ≥30 MPa; bond strength ≥2.0 MPa; impact resistance grade II, no cracking or peeling; hardness 4H; solids ≥65; water resistance slight discoloration within 7 days, 20% H2SO4 no change at 2 days, 25% NaOH no change at 2 days, 10% NaCl no change at 3 days, 120# gasoline no change at 2 days (all per GB/T 22374-2008); fire performance Bf1; slip resistance (dry friction coefficient) ≥0.50; abrasion (750 g/500 r) ≤0.30 g; drying surface ≤6 h, full ≤24 h; VOC ≤120 g/L; benzene, free formaldehyde, toluene+xylene and soluble heavy metals not detected; bright, flat surface with full film.
- Basic data table: storage 5–25 °C for 12 months; PU resin; solids 65%; Huntsman (USA) curing agent; BYK (Germany) additives; hardness 4H; acid resistance (20% H2SO4) slight discoloration at 2 days; alkali resistance (20% NaOH) no change at 2 days; scrub resistance 100,000 cycles; surface dry 6 h, full dry 48 h; net weight per set 6 kg; steel and plastic pails. Note: this table disagrees with the performance data above on acid, alkali and full-dry time.

**Safety**
- Store in a cool, dry place; stir first if some grades have separated in long storage; weigh base and curing agent in the stated ratio to avoid incomplete hardening; use within pot life; do not apply the topcoat in rain or cold to avoid hazing, color separation and white spots; wash skin contact with soap and water.
- Emergency: remove contaminated clothing at once; if vapor is inhaled move to fresh air; skin contact: wash with soap and plenty of water; eye contact: rinse with plenty of water and seek medical help; if swallowed a doctor decides whether to induce vomiting.

summary.zh: 聚氨酯地坪底漆（A组份 BATOV-8001）与配套聚氨酯底漆固化剂（BATOV-G801），属溶剂型的聚氨酯预聚物涂料，作为混凝土封闭底漆使用，具有优异的渗透性能，能有效地封闭混凝土结构的毛细孔，提高地坪涂料与混凝土基体的粘结性能。涂装体系具有防尘防潮、高耐磨、施工快捷、维护方便等特点，性价比高，是一般生产车间、办公室的首选涂装系统。
summary.en: Solvent-borne polyurethane prepolymer coating (Part A BATOV-8001 with matching curing agent BATOV-G801) used as a concrete sealing primer. It penetrates well and seals the capillary pores of concrete, improving adhesion between the floor coating and the concrete substrate. The system is dust- and moisture-proof, highly abrasion resistant, quick to apply and easy to maintain, and is the first-choice system for ordinary workshops and offices.

uses.zh: 用于混凝土的防护，适用于聚氨酯地坪与环氧地坪涂装系统的基层底漆。
uses.en: Concrete protection; base primer for polyurethane and epoxy floor coating systems.

summary.zh: 聚氨酯地坪中涂（A组份 BATOV-8002）与配套聚氨酯地坪中涂固化剂（B组份 BATOV-G802）是一种双组分、溶剂型、可厚涂的聚氨酯中涂地坪涂料。与各类底漆配套使用，可作为嵌缝填补材料、聚氨酯中涂漆以及中层砂浆漆（配石英砂），该层漆具有提高整个地坪涂装系统的厚度、强度、载重及耐冲击等优点，具有较高的耐冲击性以及粘结强度。
summary.en: Two-component, solvent-borne, high-build polyurethane body coat (Part A BATOV-8002 with curing agent Part B BATOV-G802). Used over primers as a joint/crack filler, polyurethane body coat or mortar layer (with quartz sand); it increases the thickness, strength, load capacity and impact resistance of the whole flooring system, with high impact resistance and bond strength.

uses.zh: 适用于地坪涂装系统中的中涂找平层、砂浆层、压砂层、透明面漆层等，作为油漆粘结料使用。
uses.en: Used as a binder in the body-coat leveling layer, mortar layer, broadcast (sand-scatter) layer and clear topcoat layer of floor coating systems.

en: High adhesion to substrate and primer
High compressive strength as a mortar binder
High bond to polyurethane topcoats
Economical

summary.zh: 聚氨酯地坪面漆（A组份 BATOV-8003）与配套聚氨酯地坪面漆固化剂（B组份 BATOV-G803），主要用于地坪漆的面涂层涂装，是一种溶剂型、双组份、色彩多样化、无接缝的高性能平涂型聚氨酯地坪面漆。涂装表面平滑美观、颜色一致、持久耐用；干燥后无气味、无毒无害。适用于聚氨酯地坪涂装系统薄涂型面漆。一般需要两遍涂装工序。
summary.en: Solvent-borne, two-component, seamless, high-performance flat-coat polyurethane floor topcoat (Part A BATOV-8003 with curing agent Part B BATOV-G803), available in many colors. The surface is smooth, attractive, uniform in color and durable; odorless and non-toxic once dry. Thin-film topcoat for polyurethane floor systems; normally applied in two coats.

uses.zh: 用于聚氨酯地坪涂装系统，适用于电器、电子、食品、医药、化工、机械等行业的制造车间和停车场、办公室、商场、仓库等场所的水泥或水磨石地面的首选涂装体系。
uses.en: Polyurethane floor coating system for cement or terrazzo floors in manufacturing workshops of the electrical, electronics, food, pharmaceutical, chemical and machinery industries, and in car parks, offices, shopping malls and warehouses.

name.zh: 微糙金属超耐磨地坪漆
name.en: Micro-textured metallic super abrasion-resistant floor coating

summary.zh: 聚氨酯超耐磨地坪漆是一种含3组份的高固含量耐磨的脂肪族金属耐磨涂料。它的有机物会发少于 1.28 lbs/gal（150 grams/liter）。它对于环氧底涂覆盖的混凝土表面有优秀黏附力和耐磨性能。脂肪族的不泛黄特性是对于暴露在阳光和紫外线区域一种理想的涂料。这种涂料含有一种特殊的填料，比普通环氧树脂涂料的耐磨性提高了 150% 以上。聚氨酯超耐磨地坪漆的特别配方适用于运输频繁的区域，如厂房车间通道、仓库通道和地下车库通道等。
summary.en: A three-component, high-solids, aliphatic metallic abrasion-resistant polyurethane coating with VOC below 1.28 lbs/gal (150 g/L). It adheres well to concrete covered with an epoxy primer and is highly abrasion resistant. Being aliphatic it does not yellow, which makes it ideal for areas exposed to sunlight and UV. A special filler gives more than 150% better abrasion resistance than ordinary epoxy coatings. Formulated for high-traffic areas such as workshop aisles, warehouse aisles and underground car-park lanes.

uses.zh: 工业生产车间；飞机机库；实验室；交通频繁区域；暴露在阳光或者紫外线下的区域；所有要求耐磨性持久的区域。
uses.en: Industrial workshops; aircraft hangars; laboratories; high-traffic areas; areas exposed to sunlight or UV; any area requiring long-lasting abrasion resistance.

施工前用电动搅拌机在钢质混合容器中按正确比例搅拌 A、B 组份（300–400 转/分钟），低速搅拌至少一分钟直至均匀，然后加入 C 组份色浆再搅拌一分钟
v.en: Mix Parts A and B in the correct ratio in a steel container with an electric mixer (300–400 rpm), at least 1 min at low speed until uniform, then add Part C color paste and mix for another minute

v.zh: 3/8″ 拉毛滚筒和滚筒托盘（18 英寸滚筒和托盘为理想工具）；滚筒在托盘中保持湿润，轻轻辗滚去除多余涂料；在地面滚涂 3 组 8–10 英寸的涂层带；湿膜厚度保持在 3–3.5 mils（76–89 μm）；涂得太厚会出现气泡，太薄则缺乏光泽；不时用滚筒在托盘中搅拌涂料以防止填料沉淀；最后转 90 度沿整个施工区域不间断笔直再滚涂一次以减少滚筒印子；颜色不均则重复该步骤
v.en: 3/8″ nap roller and roller tray (18-inch roller and tray ideal). Keep the roller wet in the tray and roll off excess to avoid dripping; roll three 8–10 inch bands across the floor; keep wet film at 3–3.5 mils (76–89 μm) for the intended appearance, texture and color. Too thick causes bubbles; too thin lacks gloss. Re-stir the paint in the tray with the roller from time to time to stop filler settling. Finish by rolling again at 90° in continuous straight passes across the whole area to reduce roller marks; repeat if the color is still uneven

v.zh: 水泥基层应坚实，抗压强度最低 25 N/m㎡，最低拉拔强度 1.5 N/m㎡；表面干燥，无油、油脂、表面处理剂和涂料等污染物；有疑问先做小面积测试
v.en: Cement substrate must be sound, with minimum compressive strength 25 N/mm² and minimum pull-off strength 1.5 N/mm²; surface dry and free of oil, grease, surface treatments and coatings; test a small area if in doubt

v.zh: 无尘自动喷砂、铣刨或研磨，再用吸尘器等去除所有松散物质和粉尘；建议使用前先用 BATOV-1004 作为封闭层；喷砂时调节强度，避免过度喷砂造成交叠痕迹；本产品为薄涂涂料，不能遮盖深刻的裂痕
v.en: Dust-free automatic shot blasting, milling or grinding, then remove all loose material and dust (e.g. by vacuum). A BATOV-1004 sealing coat is recommended beforehand. Adjust blasting intensity to avoid overlap marks; this is a thin-film coating and cannot cover deep cracks

name.zh: 水性聚氨酯砂浆自流平

summary.zh: 水性聚氨酯砂浆自流平是一种高性能地面材料，具有自流平性好、强度高、耐磨性强、耐化学腐蚀等特点，适用于各种场所，提供美观、耐用的地面解决方案。由水性聚氨酯树脂、水泥、石英砂等多种材料组成，是一种无溶剂、无污染的材料，具有耐腐蚀、耐高低温、耐磨、环保等特性，特别适合在食品卫生、化学品腐蚀、高温湿热、低温冷冻、重载荷强冲击的极端工业环境下使用。
summary.en: High-performance floor material with good self-leveling, high strength, strong abrasion resistance and chemical resistance, giving an attractive, durable floor for a wide range of settings. Made from waterborne polyurethane resin, cement, quartz sand and other materials; solvent-free and non-polluting, corrosion resistant, tolerant of high and low temperatures, abrasion resistant and environmentally friendly. Particularly suited to extreme industrial environments: food hygiene, chemical attack, hot and humid conditions, cold storage and heavy loads with strong impact.

uses.zh: 食品加工厂、医药制药企业、潮湿及干燥加工区、冷藏及冷冻区、奶制品厂、酿酒厂、蒸馏车间、实验室、化学品加工厂、纸浆纸业工厂、仓库及储藏区地坪等；要求防滑的区域：屠宰场、冷藏冷冻区、奶制品厂、酿酒厂、进行加热烹调、高温冲洗的区域、潮湿及干燥加工区等；停车场、电子、仓储、医药和重载荷系统等场所地面。适用于对卫生、环保、耐磨、耐压等性能有较高要求的场所。
uses.en: Floors in food processing plants, pharmaceutical plants, wet and dry processing areas, cold and frozen storage, dairies, breweries, distilleries, laboratories, chemical plants, pulp and paper mills, warehouses and storage areas; non-slip areas such as slaughterhouses, cold/frozen storage, dairies, breweries, cooking and hot-wash areas and wet/dry processing areas; car parks, electronics, warehousing, pharmaceutical and heavy-load facilities. Suited to places with high demands on hygiene, environmental performance, abrasion and compressive resistance.

zh: 健康环保：材料不含溶剂成分，VOC 排放量几乎为 0
耐化学品腐蚀：可耐受酸碱盐、醋酸、果酸、汽油等一千多种元素的腐蚀
耐水解性能：长期水泡不变色、不脱落
抗菌性：聚氨酯特殊成分是惰性元素，不易滋生细菌和霉菌
耐高低温：可在低温 -40℃ 至高温 140℃ 的环境中保持其原有的物理性能，不会出现低温脆化和高温软化，且和耐受 180℃ 短时热冲击
耐冲击、磨损：受到外力冲击不会发生碎裂的现象，而且更加耐磨、耐压
安全防滑：地面潮湿也不易滑倒，并且可根据具体需求定制光面和防滑面
en: Healthy and environmentally friendly: solvent-free, VOC emissions close to zero
Chemical resistance: withstands acids, alkalis, salts, acetic acid, fruit acids, gasoline and over a thousand other substances (as stated)
Hydrolysis resistance: no discoloration or peeling after long water immersion
Antibacterial: the polyurethane's special components are inert, so bacteria and mold do not easily grow
High/low temperature: keeps its physical properties from -40 °C to 140 °C without low-temperature embrittlement or high-temperature softening, and tolerates short thermal shock at 180 °C
Impact and wear resistance: does not shatter under impact; more abrasion and compression resistant
Safe, slip resistant: not slippery when wet; smooth or anti-slip finish available on request

v.zh: 混凝土基层要干燥，含水率应小于 8%，最小抗拉强度 2 MPa
v.en: Concrete substrate must be dry, moisture content below 8%, minimum tensile strength 2 MPa

v.zh: 环境温度 15℃–25℃ 为较佳
按出厂配比配料；先将 AC 组分搅拌均匀加入 C 组分搅拌后，边搅拌边加入 D 组分，搅拌时长不少于 2 分钟；不可加稀料和水
v.en: Batch to the factory ratio; first stir the 'AC' components until uniform, add component C, then add component D while stirring; mix for at least 2 min; do not add thinner or water

v.zh: 素地抛丸 – 切割锚固槽 – 底层施工（2 kg/m²）– 面层施工（6 kg/m²）
v.en: Shot-blast substrate – cut anchor grooves – primer layer (2 kg/m²) – topcoat layer (6 kg/m²)

v.zh: 密封储存在 5–35℃ 的干燥、阴凉、通风良好的环境中，避免高温和火源；运输时码放平稳，保证车厢环境干燥、封闭，严格防潮、防冻、防晒、防雨淋；A 和 B 组份必须避免霜冻
v.en: Sealed, in a dry, cool, well-ventilated place at 5–35 °C away from heat and ignition sources; stack securely in a dry, closed vehicle during transport; protect strictly from damp, frost, sun and rain; Parts A and B must be kept frost-free
